prompt: Find something at least 20 feet away and focus on it.
Slowly roll your eyes in a full circle, clockwise then counter-clockwise.
Hold your thumb close to your face, focus on it, then shift focus to a far object. Repeat 5 times.
Close your eyes and gently cup your palms over them. Breathe slowly.
Trace a slow figure-eight with your eyes without moving your head.
Look up-left, then down-right. Then up-right, then down-left. Repeat 5 times.
